d: The mridangam is a revered South Indian percussion instrument central to Carnatic classical music, known for its rich tonal quality and rhythmic complexity. Among the finest exponents of this art is Neyveli B. Venkatesh, a celebrated mridangam virtuoso renowned for his precision, creativity, and emotive playing. With a career that spans decades, Venkatesh has captivated audiences worldwide through his impeccable sense of rhythm (laya) and profound understanding of Carnatic music.
